headlines.text: Looking back to 2024, when Chris Jericho vs. Tomohiro Ishii clashed for the ROH World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.03. It marked Chris Jericho's 10th match with the title on the line. Championship gold always raises the stakes.

Flash back to 2019, when the AEW World Heavyweight Title was up for grabs as Chris Jericho vs. Scorpio Sky went to war, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.62. Scorpio Sky was challenging for gold for the very first time. A hard-fought battle for the gold.

Flash back to 2025, when Konosuke Takeshita vs. Roderick Strong met in a Continental Classic League Match, in the show-closing main event slot on Collision, rated 7.12 ? a solid showing, part of the special Thanksgiving card.

secondaries.text: Back on this day in 2024, Brody King vs. Darby Allin met in a Continental Classic League Match, serving as the night's main event on Dynamite, rated 7.38 ? a good, competitive contest ? part of that year's Thanksgiving Eve '24.
Back on this day in 2019, AEW welcomed Kris Statlander for the first time against Bea Priestley vs. Emi Sakura vs. Hikaru Shida, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.63.

Looking back to 2025, when PAC vs. Mike Bailey met in a Continental Classic League Match, setting the tone as the night's opener on Collision, rated 7.66 ? a solid showing ? part of that year's Thanksgiving.
